name: wenmi-writing
description: 文秘写作：统一账号的多Agent协同小说创作平台

scripts.build: npm run build -w @wenmi/contracts && npm run build -w @wenmi/api && npm run build -w @wenmi/worker && npm run build -w @wenmi/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @wenmi/contracts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WORKER,WEB --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @wenmi/api" "npm run dev -w @wenmi/worker" "npm run dev -w @wenmi/web"
scripts.test:fast: npm run build -w @wenmi/contracts && vitest run tests/foundation/api-health.test.ts tests/foundation/contracts.test.ts tests/foundation/migration.test.ts tests/contract/repository-isolation.test.ts tests/fault-injection/runtime-integrity-fences.test.ts tests/integration/security/request-policy.test.ts tests/integration/security/runtime-session.test.ts tests/integration/security/membership.test.ts tests/integration/security/admin-platform.test.ts tests/integration/domain/api-flow.test.ts tests/integration/domain/volume-plan-generation.test.ts tests/integration/domain/story-event-generation.test.ts tests/integration/domain/event-chapter-outlines.test.ts tests/integration/domain/chapter-outline-v2.test.ts tests/integration/creation/single-chapter-pipeline.test.ts tests/integration/experience/setting-catalog.test.tsx tests/integration/experience/setting-collaboration-panel.test.tsx tests/integration/data-safety/backup-restore.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @wenmi/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @wenmi/api && npm run typecheck -w @wenmi/worker && npm run typecheck -w @wenmi/web && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run verify:capabilities && npm run typecheck && npm run test:fast && npm run build
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify:capabilities && npm run typecheck && npm run test:full && npm run build
